label: D2: reached S1 when S1 was not the last rewarded state, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO). 98% of activation mass is on steps where state S1 is shown (on S2 it is almost silent). It fires either way, after a1 (common) or after a2 (rare). Inside S1-at-D2 it fires mostly when the last trial did not end in a rewarded S1, i.e. S1 is new: prev_state S2, or S1 unrewarded. Repeated rewarded S1 visits are the main false positives. It also fades strongly with episode time: rate is 0.16 at trials 0-9 and about 0 after trial 70. The agent can only get that time variable from its slowly drifting hidden state, not from an input. All predicate variables are observed by D2, and no future variable is used. Strongest activations: S1 reached right after a switch from a2/S2 early in the episode. Activation decays over repeated S1 visits (1.0 -> 0.46 -> 0.16). Dev scores: F1 0.73, mass recall 0.91. Simpler options: D2 & S1 alone gives F1 0.45 (mass 0.98); adding only ep_trial<60 gives F1 0.63. Not explained by the hidden good state, this trial's reward, or the policy logit.
